task_semantics.N: no inner/outer-race bearing fault; includes healthy and non-bearing motor faults
task_semantics.IR: pure or compound inner-race bearing fault
task_semantics.OR: pure or compound outer-race bearing fault

support_rule: per class, SHA256 order selects 3 runs at 20 Nm and 2 runs at 40 Nm

block_protocol_draft.local_m8: eight contiguous non-overlapping blocks within a stable high plateau
block_protocol_draft.distributed_m8: eight non-overlapping blocks spread over the 90-s speed profile

remaining_gates: all selected files must decode to time plus eight synchronous channels
keyphase must provide valid speed coverage for all selected files
bearing specimen identity is not documented; claims are run-disjoint, not specimen-disjoint
BPFO/BPFI order constants must be taken from the dataset article, not tuned on query
